prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a parking lot collision. The patient had 28 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1392; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of neck and back pain. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the type of impact described, and the presenting symptoms are plausible for this kind of crash. Over the course of 28 visits, care included manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home exercise instruction. The treatment followed a typical progression and was gradually reduced in frequency as the patient's pain and range of motion improved. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the presence of soft tissue injury to the cervical and lumbar regions. No prior injury to these body areas is known from the patient's history. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no repeated or duplicate entries. At discharge the patient was improving, with remaining symptoms expected to resolve with continued home exercise.
